cells.quote: One major conclusion of the study indicated that youth programs must expand and change to address the diverse and changing characteristics, needs, and interests of adolescents and their families. It discovered that structured out-of-school time, leadership experiences, and adult mentoring plays a vital role in helping young people achieve success [11].
cells.note: The study text reports the cited 4-H study's conclusion but does not state an explicit comparison group or effect size; the contrast is therefore only implicit.
